basic_profile.bio: A curious individual based in Boston, just starting their journey on Reddit and exploring the world of coding. They're a recent graduate in economics, with a growing interest in technology and how it intertwines with data analysis. They spend most of their online time in the late evenings, juggling their day job as a data analyst intern with their coding aspirations. Single and enjoying the freedom to explore new hobbies, they often find themselves drawn to podcasts and philosophical discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a foundational understanding of economics from their undergraduate degree. Currently self-teaching JavaScript via online tutorials and community forums. They are also exploring the application of econometrics in tech.
